the_finding: ⛔ A COVERAGE INSTRUMENT REPORTS COVERAGE OF ITS OWN PATTERN, NEVER OF THE DOCUMENT — and two instruments disagreeing is how it surfaced. `test_every_fraction_and_percentage_is_bound_or_declared` reported ZERO unbound figures in emc-fusion-partner-stratification.md while `claim_coverage.py` reported 155 numbered sentences in the same file read by nothing. Both readings were correct. `_CENSUS` matches `\d+/\d+|\d+(?:\.\d+)? ?%` and nothing else, so a cohort size, a published p-value, a hazard ratio and a measurement in cm or months were never inside the surface it enumerated. MEASURED BEFORE ANY BINDING WAS WRITTEN, over those four notations: 74 sites, 39 inside a binding, 35 bound to nothing and declared nowhere. ⭐ WHAT THE UNCOVERED SET CONTAINED IS THE FINDING, NOT ITS SIZE: `P = .728`, the published test carrying §3.3's entire metastasis negative; `p = 0.0034` at the appendix restatement of what the paper itself calls 'the single most quotable number in this document'; and every statement of Paioli 2021's three p-values, the third independent test of the partner. ⚠ AND A SEPARATE ONE-FACT-ONE-PLACE DEFECT UNDERNEATH: Paioli's three p-values had no structured home at all — they were typed inside an English sentence in a JSON string, stated at six manuscript sites, derivable by nothing. Promoted to `published_p_values` fields in the generator; no pooled quantity changed and `--check` passes.
⛔_what_did_not_move: THE COVERAGE HALF, ALMOST. Sentence coverage went 50/271 -> 57/271: binding 35 figures moved SEVEN sentences, because a sentence counts as covered when ANY instrument reads it and most of these figures sat in sentences already counted. 214 sentences are still read by nothing. ⛔ AUT-COV-001'S MECHANISM IS UNREFUTED and this cycle is evidence FOR it, not against it. ⚠ ALSO NOT MOVED: 22 of 32 publication endpoints still have no instrument at all. This paper is the only one with a mutation harness. Nothing in this cycle touched the other 31.
